list.title: Aging Pipe Replacement and Flange Welding Repair
list.hazard: Residual flammable gas explosion, fire from welding sparks
list.measure: Verify 0% LEL, isolate combustibles within 11m, and assign fire watch

list.title: Substation High-Voltage Switchgear Inspection and Cable Replacement
list.hazard: Electric shock from switch misoperation, arc flash from residual charge
list.measure: Implement individual LOTO, verify zero voltage with detector, and discharge grounding rod

list.title: Excavation and Shoring Installation for Piping Burial
list.hazard: Explosion from underground utility damage, burial due to slope failure
list.measure: Perform utility detection and manual excavation, maintain safe slope, and monitor instruments

list.title: Radiographic Testing (RT) for New Pipe Weld Quality Inspection
list.hazard: Radiation exposure, unauthorized entry into controlled areas during night work
list.measure: Calculate safe distance and install boundary rope, assign dedicated guard, and carry survey meter

list.title: Internal Precision Inspection and Residue Removal of Nitrogen-Purged Tanks
list.hazard: Asphyxiation due to residual nitrogen, isolation in confined spaces
list.measure: Forced ventilation before/during entry, oxygen monitoring, and mandatory external watchman

list.title: Crane Lifting and Moving for Heavy Equipment Installation
list.hazard: Equipment tip-over due to ground bearing failure, crushing by falling cargo
list.measure: Reinforce outrigger pads, follow 2-line hitching, and perform 10cm test lift

list.title: Factory Roof Panel Repair and MEWP (Rental) Operation
list.hazard: Fall from damaged corroded roof panels, electric shock from high-voltage lines
list.measure: Install load-distributing scaffolds, double-tie safety harnesses, and maintain electrical clearance
